name: Ranjith V P
about_me: Software Development Engineer with 2+ years of experience building AI-integrated production systems, Python-based data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure on AWS. Experienced in LLM integration, medical data analytics, and deploying containerized applications using Kubernetes, Terraform, and Jenkins CI/CD.

Certified in Generative AI (MIT AU-KBC), with practical experience fine-tuning LLaMA models, developing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using LangChain, and integrating AI capabilities into real-world applications. Interested in building reliable, scalable, and production-ready AI systems.

My technical experience spans backend development, cloud infrastructure, automation, and AI engineering. I enjoy connecting application development with infrastructure and deployment workflows to build systems that are maintainable, observable, and efficient.

I am particularly interested in solving practical engineering problems, taking ownership of solutions from development to deployment, and working at the intersection of software engineering, cloud platforms, and applied AI. I continuously explore new technologies and engineering practices to improve system reliability, performance, and scalability.
